39;08.02.2023;Сидорова;Южный;Сайт;Новый;24;46000;1;190000;Нет;Холост;Потреб;Ж;Неполное;Нет

# Load data directly from the string
credit <- read.table(
  text = csv_data,
  header = TRUE,
  sep = ";",
  dec = ".",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Rename target column to match the original logic
names(credit)[names(credit) == "Давать_кредит"] <- "Давать кредит"

print("✅ Data loaded successfully!")
print(head(credit, 5))

# Column names and dimensions
cat("\nColumn names:\n"); print(names(credit))
cat("\nDimensions:\n"); print(dim(credit))

# Descriptive statistics
num_idx <- sapply(credit, is.numeric)
cat("\nDescriptive statistics (numeric columns):\n")
print(summary(credit[, num_idx, drop = FALSE]))
cat("\nTarget variable distribution:\n")
print(table(credit[["Давать кредит"]]))

# ==========================================
# 2. DATA PREPARATION & TRAIN/TEST SPLIT
# ==========================================
target <- "Давать кредит"
stopifnot(target %in% names(credit))
credit[[target]] <- factor(credit[[target]])  # Binary factor: "Да"/"Нет"

# Fix factor levels for categorical predictors across the whole dataset
is_char <- sapply(credit, is.character)
is_char[names(is_char) == target] <- FALSE
for (nm in names(credit)[is_char]) credit[[nm]] <- factor(credit[[nm]])

# Stratified split 2/3 – 1/3
set.seed(123)
idx_yes <- which(credit[[target]] == "Да")
idx_no  <- which(credit[[target]] == "Нет")
tr_yes  <- sample(idx_yes, floor(length(idx_yes) * 2/3))
tr_no   <- sample(idx_no,  floor(length(idx_no)  * 2/3))
idx_tr  <- sort(c(tr_yes, tr_no))

train <- credit[idx_tr, ]
test  <- credit[-idx_tr, ]

# Drop first 6 service columns (as per methodology)
drop_n <- min(6, ncol(credit) - 1)
service_cols <- setdiff(names(credit)[seq_len(drop_n)], target)

train_ml <- train[, setdiff(names(train), service_cols), drop = FALSE]
test_ml  <- test [, setdiff(names(test ), service_cols), drop = FALSE]

bad_cols <- c(target, "Давать кредит(число)")
features <- setdiff(names(train_ml), bad_cols)

# Sync factor levels & convert numeric-like strings
for (nm in features) {
  if (is.factor(train_ml[[nm]]) || is.factor(test_ml[[nm]])) {
    all_lvls <- union(levels(train_ml[[nm]]), levels(test_ml[[nm]]))
    if (is.factor(train_ml[[nm]])) train_ml[[nm]] <- factor(train_ml[[nm]], levels = all_lvls)
    if (is.factor(test_ml [[nm]])) test_ml [[nm]] <- factor(test_ml [[nm]], levels = all_lvls)
  }
  if (is.character(train_ml[[nm]])) train_ml[[nm]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", train_ml[[nm]], fixed = TRUE)))
  if (is.character(test_ml [[nm]])) test_ml [[nm]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", test_ml [[nm]], fixed = TRUE)))
}

# Universal numeric matrix (for kNN/LDA/SVM)
mm_formula <- as.formula(paste("~", paste(sprintf("`%s`", features), collapse = " + ")))
tr_terms   <- terms(mm_formula, data = train_ml)

Xtr_mm <- model.matrix(tr_terms, data = train_ml)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
Xte_mm <- model.matrix(tr_terms, data = test_ml )[, -1, drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(Xtr_mm), colnames(Xte_mm)))

# Standardization
sc_mean <- colMeans(Xtr_mm)
sc_sd   <- apply(Xtr_mm, 2, sd); sc_sd[sc_sd == 0 | is.na(sc_sd)] <- 1
Xtr_sc  <- scale(Xtr_mm, center = sc_mean, scale = sc_sd)
Xte_sc  <- scale(Xte_mm, center = sc_mean, scale = sc_sd)

y_tr <- train_ml[[target]]
y_te <- test_ml [[target]]

# ==========================================
# 3. MODEL TRAINING & EVALUATION
# ==========================================

# 3.1 CART: Decision Tree with 1-SE pruning
library(rpart)
rtree <- rpart(
  formula = as.formula(paste("`", target, "` ~ .", sep = "")),
  data    = train_ml[, c(features, target)],
  method  = "class",
  control = rpart.control(minsplit = 10, minbucket = 5, cp = 0.0005, xval = 10, maxdepth = 8)
)
cp_tab <- rtree$cptable
imin   <- which.min(cp_tab[, "xerror"])
cp_1se <- max(cp_tab[cp_tab[, "xerror"] <= cp_tab[imin, "xerror"] + cp_tab[imin, "xstd"], "CP"])
rtree_1se <- prune(rtree, cp = cp_1se)

if (rtree_1se$frame$var[1] == "<leaf>") {
  rtree_p <- prune(rtree, cp = cp_tab[imin, "CP"])
} else { rtree_p <- rtree_1se }
if (rtree_p$frame$var[1] == "<leaf>") rtree_p <- rtree

plot(rtree_p, uniform = TRUE, branch = 0.5, margin = 0.06, main = "CART: Decision Tree Visualization")
text(rtree_p, use.n = TRUE, all = TRUE, cex = 0.8)

pred_tree <- predict(rtree_p, newdata = test_ml[, features], type = "class")
cat("\nConfusion Matrix (CART):\n"); print(table(Actual = y_te, Predicted = pred_tree))

# 3.2 LDA (Linear Discriminant Analysis)
library(MASS)
Xtr_df <- as.data.frame(Xtr_sc); Xte_df <- as.data.frame(Xte_sc)
sd_by_class <- sapply(split(Xtr_df, y_tr), function(d) apply(d, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE))
bad_cols_lda <- which(apply(sd_by_class, 1, function(v) any(is.na(v) | v < 1e-8)))

if (length(bad_cols_lda)) {
  Xtr_lda <- Xtr_df[, -bad_cols_lda, drop = FALSE]
  Xte_lda <- Xte_df[, colnames(Xtr_lda), drop = FALSE]
} else { Xtr_lda <- Xtr_df; Xte_lda <- Xte_df }

df_lda_tr <- data.frame(Xtr_lda, y = y_tr)
df_lda_te <- data.frame(Xte_lda, y = y_te)

lda_model <- lda(y ~ ., data = df_lda_tr, tol = 1e-4)
lda_pred  <- predict(lda_model, newdata = df_lda_te)$class
cat("\nConfusion Matrix (LDA):\n"); print(table(Actual = y_te, Predicted = lda_pred))

# 3.3 k-Nearest Neighbors (k=3 and k=9)
library(class)
knn_pred_k3 <- knn(train = Xtr_sc, test = Xte_sc, cl = y_tr, k = 3)
cat("\nkNN (k=3) Confusion Matrix:\n"); print(table(Actual = y_te, Predicted = knn_pred_k3))

knn_pred_k9 <- knn(train = Xtr_sc, test = Xte_sc, cl = y_tr, k = 9)
cat("\nkNN (k=9) Confusion Matrix:\n"); print(table(Actual = y_te, Predicted = knn_pred_k9))

# 3.4 Multinomial Logistic Regression
library(nnet)
logit_model <- multinom(
  formula = as.formula(paste("`", target, "` ~ .", sep = "")),
  data    = train_ml[, c(features, target)], trace = FALSE
)
logit_pred <- predict(logit_model, newdata = test_ml[, features])
cat("\nConfusion Matrix (Multinomial Logit):\n"); print(table(Actual = y_te, Predicted = logit_pred))

# 3.5 Naive Bayes
library(e1071)
nb_model <- naiveBayes(
  formula = as.formula(paste("`", target, "` ~ .", sep = "")),
  data    = train_ml[, c(features, target)]
)
nb_pred <- predict(nb_model, newdata = test_ml[, features])
cat("\nConfusion Matrix (Naive Bayes):\n"); print(table(Actual = y_te, Predicted = nb_pred))

# 3.6 SVM (RBF Kernel)
svm_model <- svm(x = Xtr_sc, y = y_tr, kernel = "radial", probability = TRUE)
svm_pred  <- predict(svm_model, newdata = Xte_sc)
cat("\nConfusion Matrix (SVM, RBF):\n"); print(table(Actual = y_te, Predicted = svm_pred))

# 3.7 Random Forest
library(randomForest)
features_rf <- intersect(features, intersect(names(train_ml), names(test_ml)))
for (nm in features_rf) {
  if (is.character(train_ml[[nm]])) {
    train_ml[[nm]] <- factor(train_ml[[nm]])
    test_ml [[nm]] <- factor(test_ml [[nm]], levels = levels(train_ml[[nm]]))
  }
}
Xrf_tr <- train_ml[, features_rf, drop = FALSE]
Xrf_te <- test_ml [, features_rf, drop = FALSE]
y_tr   <- train_ml[[target]]
y_te   <- test_ml [[target]]

mtry_auto <- max(1, floor(sqrt(ncol(Xrf_tr))))
rf_model <- randomForest(x = Xrf_tr, y = y_tr, ntree = 300, mtry = mtry_auto, importance = TRUE, na.action = na.roughfix)
rf_pred <- predict(rf_model, newdata = Xrf_te)
cat("\nConfusion Matrix (Random Forest):\n"); print(table(Actual = y_te, Predicted = rf_pred))

varImpPlot(rf_model, main = "Feature Importance (Random Forest)")

# ==========================================
# 4. MODEL COMPARISON SUMMARY
# ==========================================
acc <- function(y_true, y_hat) mean(y_true == y_hat)
summary_acc <- data.frame(
  Model    = c("CART (1-SE)", "LDA", "kNN (k=3)", "kNN (k=9)",
               "Multinomial Logit", "Naive Bayes", "SVM (RBF)", "Random Forest"),
  Accuracy = c(
    acc(y_te, pred_tree), acc(y_te, lda_pred), acc(y_te, knn_pred_k3), acc(y_te, knn_pred_k9),
    acc(y_te, logit_pred), acc(y_te, nb_pred), acc(y_te, svm_pred), acc(y_te, rf_pred)
  ), row.names = NULL
)
summary_acc <- summary_acc[order(-summary_acc$Accuracy), ]
cat("\n Model Accuracy Summary:\n"); print(summary_acc, row.names = FALSE)
